minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  2nd Floor Council Chambers
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Strategic Planning Committee Meeting

  HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, February 7, 2019
  5:00 PM
MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time  February 7, 2019/ 5:00pm

IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Julian Gold MD, Vice Mayor John Mirisch, City Treasurer
  Howard Fisher, Facilitator Karen Orlansky, City Manager Mahdi
  Aluzri, Honorable Kathy Reims, Health & Safety Commissioner
  Myra Lurie, Health & Safety Commissioner Daniel Nazarian,
  Human Relations Commissioner Ori Blumenfield, Planning
  Commissioner Lori Greene Gordon, Cultural Heritage
  Commissioner Craig Corman, Sharon Ignarro, Director of
  Community Development Susan Healy Keene, Director of Public
  Works Shana Epstein, Director of Community Services Nancy Hunt
  Coffey, Assistant Director of Community Development Ryan
  Gohlich, Marketing and Economic Sustainability Manager Laura
  Biery, Policy and Management Analyst Cindy Owens, Senior
  Planner Timmi Tway, Transportation Planner Jessie Holzer

  1.  Public Comment
   None.

  2. Discussion with Stakeholders in the La Cienega/Wilshire Focus Area
   Panel of various stakeholders within the area
   Erin Anderson with Palisades Capital Partners who manages
  Garden House, a mixed use development project on Wilshire Blvd.
   Alexander and Abraham Assil with Westland Development Group,
  who own the Stinking Rose restaurant property.
   Deep Sethi who is one of the owners of restaurants Bombay Palace
  and Double Barrel
   John DeLuca who owns the apartments on S. Hamilton Dr.
   Julian Javor whose family owns property on La Cienaga Blvd.
   Discussion among stakeholders about mixed use and future developments

  3. Committee Updates
   There will not be a second meeting scheduled for the month of February.

  4. Confirm Future Meeting Dates
   Next meeting to be scheduled on March 7, 2019.

  5. Adjourn
 Date / Time  February 7, 2019/ 6:23pm
